verdict.rationale: LobeHub publishes a first-party changelog of feature updates, which covers the changelog part of the story. The 'Migrate from Local Database' doc is a one-time data-storage migration, not per-release upgrade notes, and the Docker Compose self-hosting docs don't mention upgrading. missing for 10: version numbers tied to changelog entries, self-host upgrade or migration notes per release, a documented repair/rollback path, independent corroboration of safe updates.
